description: Ακτογραμμή Περιοχής Δήμου Πατρέων is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalog.data.patras.gr. Precise mapping of the land-sea interface along the entire length of the Municipality's coastal front. Coverage: GR. The portal shows the English title as "Coastline of the Municipality of Patras" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include ακτογραμμή, Δήμος Πατρέων. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GEOJSON. The listing shows 2026-05-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
